name: Zsolt Varjú
summary: Software developer and platform operator, deliberately broader than full stack. I build web applications end to end, design the ETL pipelines that feed them, and run the production infrastructure they depend on, currently as sole developer and operator of a document search platform on a project for the European Space Agency. AI-assisted development is a core working method, not a novelty. Heading towards system architecture.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Sole developer and operator of a document search platform on a project for the European Space Agency, owned end to end from the user interface down to the servers it runs on.
React frontend and Node.js backend over a search stack built on Apache Solr, with RabbitMQ for messaging, Neo4j for relationships and Tika for document extraction.

Design and operate multi-mission ingestion pipelines in Python: scheduled transfers, search schema design, and table extraction from PDFs and spreadsheets with rejection audits returned to the data owners.
Run Ubuntu servers on Azure: nginx with TLS and access control, containerised services, CI, backups, and regular vulnerability remediation under formal change control.

Led a phased frontend quality programme: vendor bundle cut by roughly three quarters, JavaScript payload down a third, CSS down more than half, every outstanding lint error cleared, unnecessary React re-renders reduced by 80%.
Coordinate directly with mission teams and IT on requirements, formal bug reports, escalations, change records and effort estimates for new work.

experience.title: Quality Assurance Tester
bullets: Manual functional testing of web pages across browsers and devices, identifying and reporting defects.
Verified pages against graphic design specifications and fed detailed corrections back to designers and developers.
Maintained quality standards across a large portfolio of Slovak municipal and commercial websites.
Documented test results and corrective actions, working independently to fixed deadlines.
